topics.label: Introduction and Course Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series, outlines key learning outcomes, and sets the clinical and biological context for the upcoming material.

topics.label: Cellular and Developmental Basis of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer develops from a stepwise breakdown in genetic regulation and tissue differentiation, and address the experimental challenges of modeling this loss of tissue architecture.

topics.label: Distinguishing Benign and Malignant Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the differences between benign and malignant neoplasms through their invasive capacity, progression patterns, clinical hazards, and histological nomenclature.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the specific physiological and mechanical processes by which primary and metastatic tumors cause systemic illness and patient death.

topics.label: Patterns of Tumor Incidence Across Tissues and Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the epidemiological frequency and mortality of tumors across different human tissues and compare cancer susceptibility across diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Principles and Evaluation of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess the clinical rationale, diagnostic techniques, and varying success rates of screening programs designed for early tumor detection.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the presentation by reviewing the learning outcomes and previewing the upcoming practicals and future lectures.
